# Dev-only telemetry gate helper + enforcement scan

Child of **Dev-mode telemetry upload to dev server with automatic evaluation** (AH-0MVBHRLY8004BGDN).
Test-first tracer bullet: establishes the single dev-only gate all later slices depend on,
plus the automated scan that proves upload/collection can never be reached from a production build.

## Goal

One pure, unit-tested dev-only gate controls whether telemetry collection and upload are
enabled, and an automated enforcement scan fails the suite if any production-reachable call
site could enable upload or collect-on-by-default.

## User story

As a maintainer, I want a single tested gate and a scan that catches any future code path that
could enable dev-only telemetry from a production build, so the dev-only invariant cannot
silently regress.

## Acceptance Criteria

- A pure module (e.g. `src/telemetry/devMode.ts`) exports `isDevTelemetryUploadEnabled(env, setting)`
  and `isDevTelemetryCollectionEnabled(env, setting)`; each returns true only when
  `env.DEV === true` **and** `setting.shareTelemetryDev === true`. Unit tests cover dev+on,
  dev+off, prod+on, prod+off, and a missing/undefined setting.
- The gate reads `import.meta.env.DEV` only; no other module independently decides dev
  collectability — the enforcement scan asserts the gate module is the sole decision point for
  the dev telemetry default.
- An enforcement scan test (mirroring the existing dev-only/human-stats scan style) asserts:
  (a) every module that reads `TELEMETRY_JSONL_STORAGE_KEY` and/or fetches an
  `/api/telemetry/upload` endpoint is guarded by the dev gate; (b) the collection-on-by-default
  behaviour is unreachable when `import.meta.env.DEV` is false; (c) the upload Vite plugin
  declares `apply: 'serve'` (added when the plugin lands, dep F5).
- The production bundle contains no dev-upload call site: `npm run build` (with the existing
  `check-bundle-hygiene` step) passes, and the scan covers both source-level and bundle-level
  reachability.
- All tests pass through the project test skill.

## Minimal implementation

- Add `src/telemetry/devMode.ts` with the pure gate functions (pattern: `runEndedSignal.ts`'s
  `isRunEndedSignalEnabled()`).
- Add `src/telemetry/devMode.test.ts` (pure function matrix).
- Add the enforcement scan test (source-scan style mirroring the dev-only assertions in
  `vite/plugins/configCsvPlugin.test.ts` and the human-stats scan; extend the existing
  `scripts/check-bundle-hygiene.mjs` forbidden-markers list if a bundle-level assertion is the
  cleanest fit — keep production markers untouched otherwise).
- Export the gate helpers from `src/telemetry/index.ts`.

**Key Files:**

- `src/telemetry/devMode.ts`
- `src/telemetry/devMode.test.ts`
- `src/telemetry/devModeEnforcement.test.ts`
- `src/telemetry/index.ts`
- `scripts/check-bundle-hygiene.mjs` (+ `.test.ts`)

## Dependencies

- None (tracer bullet for AH-0MVBHRLY8004BGDN).

## Deliverables

Gate module + unit tests, enforcement scan test, bundle-hygiene extension (if needed).
